name: product-category
description: Start page of a category folder. Lists every product story in its folder automatically, with filters and optional highlighted products.

result_label.description: Placeholders: {count} = products shown, {variants} = sum of their variant counts. Updates live while filtering.

subcategories.description: Sidebar links (no images) or image chips (with thumbnails) above the results.

highlighted_products.description: Shown as a row above the full product list.

picker_contract.plugin: ext-picker-content (org field plugin; stored value shape UNKNOWN)
picker_contract.startsWith_note: Field options are per component schema, NOT per brand. The shared schema can't hold 'fischer/produkte' AND 'fischertechnik/produkte'. Default = empty (all stories; renderer keeps only component 'product'). If the plugin supports a path placeholder (e.g. '{0}/produkte' = first segment of the current story), set that instead. Open question #1.
picker_contract.normalize: normalizeProductRefs(value): value may be an array, or an object with items|stories|value|selected array. Each entry may be a string (uuid = 36-char UUID; numeric = id; else full_slug/slug) or an object carrying uuid | id | full_slug | slug (also nested under .story or .content). Output: ordered, de-duplicated list of {uuid?|id?|full_slug?}. Unknown shapes -> [] + console.warn with the raw value (dev only).
picker_contract.fetch: uuids -> cdn/stories?by_uuids_ordered=...; full_slugs -> cdn/stories?by_slugs=...; ids -> cdn/stories/{id} (parallel). Always pass language = current locale and the same version as the page (draft in preview). Keep only story.content.component === 'product'; keep editor order.
picker_contract.render: ProductTile per product (shared renderer component, NOT an editor block); variant per brand theme preset.

fallback.note: Native Storyblok multi-story reference (stores uuids, editor order). '{0}' = first path segment of the edited story = brand folder, so the native fallback IS brand-scoped. Same normalize/fetch path (uuids).

title.description: Defaults to the product/category name when empty.

og_image.description: Defaults to the first gallery image when empty.

akeneo_products.description: Products picked from Akeneo (PIM) — appended to the recommendations row after the Storyblok products. Same plugin config as the Miles & More COM demo space (offer-page.akeneo_products).

view.name: ProductCategory
view.notes: Server: fetch cdn/stories?starts_with={full_slug of this folder}&content_type=product&per_page=100&sort_by=position:asc (+ language, version) — EXCLUDES the startpage. Hand products + facet config to <ProductListing> (client) for filtering/counts. Structure: H1 row (48/58 600, 30px above/below, 12-col container); intro prose below H1 (narrow); then layout: SIDEBAR (fischer#2): left col 210 = 'Kategorien' box (header 48px bg var(--color-secondary) white 16/600 pl 18; links 14/24 600 p12 1px var(--color-panel-strong) bottom border + chevron) then 'Filter' box (same header) with facet accordions; right = count line 16/300 mb 6 + 5-col grid 210 tiles gap 24 (1146). TOP-BAR (fischertechnik#2): facet bar (padding 24 30) -> 'Kategorien' image chips 5/row 257 wide (image 257x145 + label 16/600 p 24 on var(--color-panel), static links) -> panel band var(--color-panel) with count line + 5-col grid of 257 tiles gap 24. Highlights row (if picked): above the count line, ProductTiles in the same grid geometry with h2. No pagination (source renders all). Empty filter result -> short 'Keine Produkte gefunden' (i18n dict). Breadcrumb from the layout.

styling_cues.panel_layout: contained 1380 (sidebar) / top bar + full-bleed panel band (top-bar)
styling_cues.card_border: fischer tiles: shadow rgba(0,0,0,.1) 0 0 30px, white; ft tiles: white on panel, no shadow

renderer_components: ProductListing (client: filter state, counts, result label)
